riders: Create a visible or invisible conceptual division. Choose one relation that cannot cross.
Division of Passage: Creatures and objects cannot physically cross. A creature attempting to cross makes a Strength or Charisma saving throw.

Division of Qi: Cultivation techniques, Cultivation Point transfer, Remote Technique Origin, Domain Armament control, and active Qi tethers cannot cross. A technique whose Source CL equals or exceeds yours may cross after its user succeeds on a Cultivation Check against your save DC.

Division of Sight: Vision, Truesight, visual divination, and line-of-sight targeting cannot cross. Blindsight, Tremorsense, or another sense crosses only when its physical medium remains connected around the division.

Division of Sound: Sound, audible commands, audible techniques, and sound-based communication cannot cross. Thunder damage can cross only if its Source Rule does not require sound transmission and its Source CL equals or exceeds yours.

Division of Space: Teleportation, portals, phasing, pocket-space access, summoning, and planar movement cannot cross. Equal/higher Secret or spatial authority requires a Cultivation Check against your save DC.
Division of Healing: Healing, Temporary Hit Points, condition removal, Cultivation Point restoration, and restorative tethers cannot cross. Self-healing on either side remains functional.

Division of Command: Companion commands, Formation control, Domain Armament commands, possession control, and summoned-asset orders cannot cross. Assets retain their last legal instruction or default behavior.

Division of Cause and Effect: A hostile or beneficial effect originating on one side cannot affect a target on the other side, even when its physical projectile or visual manifestation crosses. This is the most demanding form. Increase its Qi cost by 2. A Source CL equal or higher may contest with a Cultivation Check each activation.
